references.text: This reference highlights the transition from Jacob's passivity to his sons' active (but mistaken) plan of revenge.
The reference connects the cause (the dishonor heard in Gen 34:5) with the violent action that follows.
A thematic parallel that illuminates Jacob's vulnerability and pain when he loses control over his children.
Highlights a recurring theme: Jacob's pain upon learning of his sons' gross violation of the family honor.
